data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business (2016: GBP 3,031k, predominately in respect of Property and Accident and Health businesses).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 77.173m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded a positive run-off deviation of GBP 3.714m (a release), predominately in Accident & Health lines, representing an approximate 4.8% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. The report also notes current-year adverse impact on the 2017 claims ratio from storm and earthquake losses in Q3, but the prior-year movement is described as favourable run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business
The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure sourced from narrative sentence describing a 'positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k'. The report also contains a gross claims development triangle (page 37) which could be used to compute an alternative gross PYD, but the narrative explicitly quantifies a run-off deviation. It is not explicitly labelled gross or net in the sentence; interpreted here as a gross release and recorded accordingly. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 37) in thousands which was not fully reconciled to the narrative amount in this extraction.
